episodes.name: Sylvie
episodes.plot: When an armed man storms her late-night flight to Moscow, former military pilot Sylvie finds herself pulled into the cockpit to help.

translations.value: When an armed man storms her late-night flight to Moscow, former military pilot Sylvie finds herself pulled into the cockpit to help.

episodes.name: Jakub
episodes.plot: Mechanic Jakub clashes with the others about what to do next. A Wi-Fi signal brings troubling new intel on the disaster — and on some of the passengers.

translations.value: Mechanic Jakub clashes with the others about what to do next. A Wi-Fi signal brings troubling new intel on the disaster — and on some of the passengers.

episodes.name: Mathieu
episodes.plot: As the group deals with a series of mechanical crises, Terenzio challenges Mathieu's authority, and Horst makes contact with another plane.

translations.value: As the group deals with a series of mechanical crises, Terenzio challenges Mathieu's authority, and Horst makes contact with another plane.

episodes.name: Ayaz
episodes.plot: Rik organizes a hasty trial to decide Ayaz's fate, Terenzio reveals rumors of a NATO refuge, and Sylvie begins to worry about Mathieu's state of mind.

translations.value: Rik organizes a hasty trial to decide Ayaz's fate, Terenzio reveals rumors of a NATO refuge, and Sylvie begins to worry about Mathieu's state of mind.

episodes.name: Rik
episodes.plot: The mission to NATO headquarters takes a dramatic turn. Laura and Horst tend to a medical emergency. Jakub and Osman race to solve the fuel problem.

translations.value: The mission to NATO headquarters takes a dramatic turn. Laura and Horst tend to a medical emergency. Jakub and Osman race to solve the fuel problem.

episodes.name: Terenzio
episodes.plot: Emotions run high as the group makes one last desperate bid to reach safety before dawn breaks.

translations.value: Emotions run high as the group makes one last desperate bid to reach safety before dawn breaks.

episodes.name: Zara
episodes.plot: Just as the passengers settle into the rhythms of life in the bunker, a sudden food shortage forces them to consider making another risky journey.

translations.value: Just as the passengers settle into the rhythms of life in the bunker, a sudden food shortage forces them to consider making another risky journey.

episodes.name: Laura
episodes.plot: With the generator shut down, temperatures and tempers soar, sparking a tense standoff. The Colonel finds a damning piece of evidence at the air base.

translations.value: With the generator shut down, temperatures and tempers soar, sparking a tense standoff. The Colonel finds a damning piece of evidence at the air base.

episodes.name: Ines
episodes.plot: After a distressing chain of events, Thea and Mathieu lead a search for a new plane, and the officers plot their revenge on Sylvie.

translations.value: After a distressing chain of events, Thea and Mathieu lead a search for a new plane, and the officers plot their revenge on Sylvie.

episodes.name: Gia
episodes.plot: At the bunker, the trial soon gives way to more twisted schemes. The group searching for seeds encounters a disoriented stranger.

translations.value: At the bunker, the trial soon gives way to more twisted schemes. The group searching for seeds encounters a disoriented stranger.

episodes.name: Théa
episodes.plot: As Thea and team attempt to lure Gia out of the vault, Ines searches for a way back into the bunker, and Rik confides in the ambassador.

translations.value: As Thea and team attempt to lure Gia out of the vault, Ines searches for a way back into the bunker, and Rik confides in the ambassador.

episodes.name: Asil
episodes.plot: The crisis aboard the plane threatens to leave the travelers stranded. Fearing for their lives, Sylvie and the others hatch a plan to flee the bunker.

translations.title: Into the Night
translations.overview: I passeggeri e l'equipaggio di un volo notturno dirottato fanno di tutto per evitare i raggi del sole mentre un misterioso evento cosmico semina devastazione a terra.
When the sun suddenly starts killing everything in its path, passengers on an overnight flight from Brussels attempt to survive by any means necessary.
translations.tagline: The darkest hour is just before the dawn.

translations.overview: Lorsque le soleil commence soudain à tout tuer sur son chemin, les passagers d'un vol de nuit en partance de Bruxelles tentent de survivre par tous les moyens.
